newsitem.title: CANADA: Stampeder launches bid for Morgan.
newsitem.headline: Stampeder launches bid for Morgan.

text.p: Stampeder Exploration Ltd and Morgan Hydrocarbons Inc said that they have entered into an agreement in which Stampeder will make a C$500 million offer for all outstanding common shares in Morgan.
The companies said in a joint statement that Morgan shareholders can receive either C$4.75 in cash or 0.85 of a common share of Stampeder for each Morgan share.

The offer is subject to an aggregrate maximum of C$130 million in cash and 44 million common shares of Stampeder, the companies said. Morgan said its board of directors would recommend that shareholders accept the Stampeder offer.
The companies said they have significant mutual core operations in Saskatchewan and Northern Alberta.

Stampeder will mail a takeover bid circular early next week. Stampeder's offer will expire 23 days from the mailing date and is subject to certain conditions, including a minimum tender of 66-2/3 percent of Morgan's shares.
Morgan has agreed to pay a C$10 million termination fee if its shareholders accept a higher offer from a rival bidder.
